metadata.citation: Rollei Retro 80S data sheet, 2021-01-15, page 3 spectral sensitivity; APHOG forum post #40-41 (2011-06-05), 10-zone Neofin Blau densitometry. Process: Tetenal Neofin Blau, one flask to 500 ml, 6 min at 20 C; EI 80/20.
metadata.datasource: https://forum.aphog.com/index.php?thread/13483-rollei-retro-80s/&pageNo=3; archived HTML SHA256 8da29c06a10b430d4c70534550fb96a6ac242b3c8f90259e46f9e07fa68137c9; https://www.rolleianalog.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/RETRO80S_Datenblatt_EN_R012101.pdf; PDF SHA256 f37754ce4548ceab6e6902143118cea712d5bf4f1dee32488bfa37dfb02e0f45; source SHA256 5e5bdd9ac4b43739b49c3283823a8b956111991abb01d1fa75d1b95f4fe89dbb. Source-relative log-exposure reference 1.67979951368 on the Zone I-X axis; this is not an absolute lux-seconds origin. Rebuild scripts/prepare_rollei80s.py; see docs/rollei80s.md. Third-party forum densitometry, not a manufacturer curve; Zone I-X only, one stop per zone. 35 mm measurement only; no 120-specific curve and no ID-11/D-76 curve were found. The first measured zone (I, 0.05) is used as the base-density proxy, not a measured D-min. No toe below Zone I or shoulder above Zone X was measured; extensions are model assumptions. Zone IV (0.36) is lower than a smooth S-curve would suggest; it is kept as measured, not corrected. The Wallner MC 505 is an enlarging meter reading relative logD, not a calibrated diffuse densitometer. Data are from 2010-2011; current 2026 batch equivalence is unverified. The spectral ordinate is a relative log-sensitivity reading; the absolute ISO anchor is model calibration, not a film measurement. No measured base spectrum, halation PSF, RMS/MTF instrument, or scanner response is supplied. No 120-specific or ID-11/D-76 curve is available; this profile is 35 mm + Neofin Blau only. The first measured zone is a base-density proxy; no measured D-min is supplied. The toe below Zone I and shoulder above Zone X are clamped, not inferred. The spectral ordinate is relative, not absolute; the ISO anchor is model calibration. The Wallner MC 505 reading is relative logD, not a calibrated diffuse density measurement. The built-in grain and halation are class-level effects, not measured RMS/PSF.
